d:
What happens when you get the chance to make as many wishes as you want? Some desires are so strong that they only fuel the need for more! Our heroine decided not to hold back, her craving to transform her body became insatiable.

Hello everyone! I think it's time to finally publish the last part of this comic, as keeping it unreleased wouldn't make much sense anymore 😅

I'm also releasing it because a brand-new comic is coming to take its place! It's going to feature a harpy transformation and a ton of other body expansions you all love, all driven by a game-like progression system.

So, I would be really happy if you checked out my Patreon
👉
https://www.patreon.com/SirNrei
to read this new comic right now, along with many others! 😊 New comic:
